; Sixteen-byte iNES header: mapper 1, 128 KiB PRG ROM and 128 KiB CHR ROM, no trainer.
; CopiedBank0Reset: Disable rendering/interrupts, set the stack and wait for vblank before mapper
; setup and APU initialization. This exact copied bootstrap has only a local high-window decoding
; contract; actual fetches after control/PRG commits require the changed mapping.
; CopiedBank0InitializeMapper: Select control $1E, PRG zero and CHR zero before falling into CHR-
; one setup. Mapping-changing calls invalidate sequential execution in this copied high-bank
; view; natural entry remains unresolved.
; CopiedBank0WriteChrOne: Serialize five low bits of A to MMC1 CHR register one. A is
; destructively shifted four times; PRG context is preserved.
; CopiedBank0WriteChrZero: Serialize five low bits of A to MMC1 CHR register zero. A is
; destructively shifted four times; PRG context is preserved.
; CopiedBank0WriteControl: Serialize five low bits of A to MMC1 control, then fall into PRG
; serialization with A shifted four times. The control commit can replace this execution view; no
; sequential fetch contract is implied.
; CopiedBank0WritePrg: Cache A and serialize five bits to MMC1 PRG. The terminal RTS is supported as part of the whole
; copied helper under the retained-high mode-2 contract: selected high pair equals incoming A,
; shift register starts empty, and caller stack is balanced. Other mapping states still
; invalidate sequential fetch assumptions; natural invocation is unresolved.
; CopiedBank0PrgSerializerReturn:
; Return after the fifth MMC1 PRG write. This completes the copied 23-byte serializer. The high-
; window contract requires mode 2, an empty shift register and the incoming pair already
; selected, so the final commit retains this backing; the caller must supply a balanced stack.
; This static local contract does not establish a reset route or natural invocation.

; SelectCrouchPose: Clear the attack-action latch on release. Outside scripted movement, choose

; coordinates in the jump handler.
; AdvancePlayerJump: Check room-specific climb attachment points, then integrate the phase-
; indexed signed vertical displacement into screen Y and 16-bit world height. At late phases
; select a falling pose, with special bounce pacing and ability-dependent animation.
; Jump-table values are signed vertical steps. Screen Y subtracts them; world height adds upward
; movement.
; IntegratePlayerHorizontalSpeed: Clear released input latches and subtract speed from a
; fractional accumulator. Count wraps in scratch as whole-pixel displacement, then route to
; leftward or rightward movement from the stored direction.

; wrapping. Publish the column-stream PPU destination before the common continuation.
; MovePlayerRight: Move player screen X until the tracking threshold, respecting room bounds. At

; rightward camera scrolling.
; ApplyRoomScriptScene: Copy the selected script byte into the pending scene request; the

; MovePlayerRight: Move player screen X until the tracking threshold, respecting room bounds. At

; ScrollCameraRight: Advance the 16-bit camera displacement, shift twelve object X positions and
; the auxiliary sprite left, and update PPU scroll/nametable state. At tile boundaries advance
